title: Only the log's parent was resolved, so a log symlinked to a tracked file was truncated, a linked prompt could lie in the worktree, and the CLI log was unchecked
resolution: scripts/review-files.ts resolves the prompt's real path and each log's real directory, refuses a symbolic link, a hard link, or a non-file log, and opens logs with O_NOFOLLOW; the CLI log is checked too, with regression tests.

title: Node.js added the inherited NODE_V8_COVERAGE to the reviewer despite the explicit environment, and the test exempted it
resolution: The reviewer starts as /usr/bin/env -i with the allowlist, so nothing the runtime adds reaches it; the test sets NODE_V8_COVERAGE and checks the child environment without that exception.

title: OpenCode passed with its model unconfirmed, against the requirement that the expected model is confirmed before the template prints
resolution: The run's events carry no model, so make review reads it from opencode session export of the session; a missing, other, or differently varied model, or a failed export, exits 4.

title: Antigravity accepted any mention of the model ID in its log, and a CLI log left from an earlier attempt
resolution: The CLI log is emptied before each run and only its model override label lines count, each of which must name the row's label; tests for another label, a mere mention, and a stale log.

title: A log that was the prompt file or its alias was truncated before the reviewer read the prompt
resolution: A log with the prompt's device and inode, including the derived CLI log, is refused with exit status 1 before any file is opened for writing; tests for the same path, a hard link, and the CLI log.

title: File and synchronous launch errors were rethrown from runReview, and a failed prompt open leaked the log descriptor
resolution: A missing log directory or a non-file log is refused before routing, file errors become exit status 1, a launch that cannot start exits 4, and nested finally blocks close every opened descriptor; tests.

title: A route.json holding JSON null crashed the route gate and the recommendation with a TypeError
resolution: routeRecord accepts only a JSON object, so another value is a stale route for pass 1 and no recommendation later; tests for null and a malformed plan in passes 1, 2, and 3.

title: The proposal still said that this change's own reviewers run with env -u JEV_MAF_LAB
resolution: The proposal says that passes 1 and 2 of this change run through make review itself.
